notes.title: Demo Gameplay | The Blessing of Airon | Steam Next Fest
notes.notes: [p]Welcome to The Blessing of Airon gameplay demo event! The Blessing of Airon is the upcoming Horror First Person Adventure from BakertheGameMaker. [/p][p][/p][p]The  world of The Blessing of Airon suffers from the threat of Neural Demonic Phenomenae; electronics forged and then discarded by previous generations have come under control of the evil foe, and are a scourge on humanity. Mundane items such as phones and video game consoles now pose great threats to communities where they are found... and even greater temptation.[/p][p][/p][p]In this pre-recorded stream, we see Mrs. GameMaker playing through the game for the first time in many months. [/p][p][/p][p]Try out the demo and wishlist the The Blessing of Airon to learn more as the story of The Blessing of Airon unfolds.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Gameplay | The Blessing of Airon
notes.notes: [p]In The Blessing of Airon, the faithful are afflicted by the occurrence of Neural Demonic Phenomenae. Their story begins now in the early chapters of The Blessing of Airon.[/p][p][/p][p]Hundreds of years after the last computer was constructed, the electronics of the modern day afflict our descendants. They don't decay. They act unpredictably. They distort reality and screech, smolder and bleed. But they won't go away. How did things turn out this way? [/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy this introduction to the haunted world of The Blessing of Airon.[/p]
